rule: Shed needs a building permit if it is 15 m² or more
source: Toronto: When do I need a permit
notes: Zoning still applies even with no permit.

rule: No permit if shed is 15 m² or less AND one storey AND not attached AND storage only AND no plumbing
source: Toronto: When do I need a permit

rule: Accessory structure (garage, workshop, carport, pool house) over 10 m² needs a permit; attached or with plumbing always needs one
applies_when: Area > limit OR attached OR plumbing
source: Toronto: When do I need a permit

rule: Deck more than 60 cm above ground needs a permit
source: Toronto: When do I need a permit
notes: Lower decks: no permit if not part of a required exit and zoning-compliant.

rule: Any addition (new storey, attached garage, sunroom, porch, deck) needs a permit
source: Toronto: When do I need a permit

rule: Basement finishing needs a permit if it includes structural work, new plumbing/heating, underpinning, a basement entrance, or a second suite
source: Toronto: When do I need a permit

rule: Structural alterations, new or enlarged window/door openings, enclosing a deck or porch need a permit
source: Toronto: When do I need a permit

rule: Changing use (e.g. single house to multiple units) needs a permit even with no construction
source: Toronto: When do I need a permit

rule: Demolishing all or part of a building needs a permit
source: Toronto: When do I need a permit

rule: Retaining wall over 1 m high next to public property, building entrances, or publicly accessible areas needs a permit
source: Toronto: When do I need a permit

rule: Heating/plumbing changes, chimney, wood stove, backwater valve, backflow device need a permit
source: Toronto: When do I need a permit

rule: No permit: re-roofing without structural work, same-size window/door replacement in a single-unit house, insulation, furnace replacement, cabinetry, sump pump
source: Toronto: When do I need a permit
notes: Zoning compliance still required.

rule: Permitted buildings: detached house, detached houseplex; townhouse/apartment only on a lot abutting a major street
Max height = HT value on Height Overlay Map; 10.0 m if no HT value
notes: Needs overlay data for each property.

rule: Detached houseplex max height = greater of HT value or 10.0 m
Main wall height max = higher of 7.0 m or (max height - 2.5 m); must be met for >=70% of side wall width
notes: Front/rear walls: 60% (frontage >=12 m), 50% (7.5-12 m), 40% (<=7.5 m).

rule: Flat/shallow roof: main wall max = higher of 7.2 m or (max height - 2.5 m); parapet up to 0.3 m more
notes: Walls above must step back >=1.4 m.

rule: Main pedestrian entrance: lowest point no higher than 1.2 m above established grade
Total dormer width no more than 40% of main wall width below
Max storeys = ST value on Height Overlay Map; no limit if none (doesn't apply to houseplex)
Max building length 17.0 m
One-storey extension may add 2.0 m length if <=5.0 m high, <=50% of building width, >=3.0 m from side lot lines
applies_when: Detached house, frontage >12.0 m to 18.0 m

rule: Houseplex max length 19.0 m on deep lots
applies_when: Depth >=36 m & frontage <10 m, OR depth >=40 m & frontage >=10 m

rule: Rear main wall no more than 19.0 m from the required front yard setback
Max FSI = 'd' value on zone label; no limit if none; doesn't apply to houseplex or house with secondary suite
Max lot coverage = Lot Coverage Overlay value; no limit if none; 45% if overlay is lower and lot has houseplex/secondary suite
applies_when: Houseplex or secondary suite and overlay < 45%

rule: Min front yard setback 6.0 m (unless the neighbour-average rule 10.5.40.70(1) applies)
notes: Extract 10.5.40.70(1) from PDF.

rule: Min rear setback = greater of 7.5 m or 25% of lot depth
Min side setback 0.6 m
Min side setback 0.9 m
Min side setback 1.2 m
Min side setback 1.5 m
Min side setback 1.8 m
Min side setback 2.4 m
Min side setback 3.0 m
One side may be reduced up to 0.3 m if the other side increases by the same amount
Side setback 7.5 m for parts beyond the lesser of 17.0 m from front wall or 19.0 m from required front setback
Corner lot: side yard abutting a street 3.0 m
applies_when: Corner lot, frontage >=12 m, neighbour fronts that street

rule: Min lot frontage = 'f' value; 12.0 m if none
Min lot area = 'a' value; otherwise min frontage x 30 m
Max dwelling units = 'u' value on zone label
Houseplex with 2 units: max 4 bedrooms per unit; 3+ units: max 3 per unit (bachelor = 1)
notes: 3+ units limit = 3.

rule: Detached house platforms at/above 2nd storey: max 4 total, 1 per side, max 4.0 m² each
Houseplex platforms at/above 2nd storey: max 2 per unit, 1 each on front and rear
One residential building per lot; no separate rear dwelling building (garden/laneway suites handled under Ch. 150)
Permitted buildings: detached, semi-detached, townhouse, detached/semi-detached houseplex, apartment building
Max height = HT value; 10.0 m if none (houseplex: greater of HT or 10.0 m)
Main wall height = higher of 7.0 m or (max height - 2.5 m), same % rules as RD
Detached house roof above 2nd storey: max slope 5 vertical : 3 horizontal
Max building depth 17.0 m (houseplex 19.0 m on deep lots)
notes: 19.0 m if depth >=36 & frontage <10, or depth >=40 & frontage >=10.

rule: Max FSI 0.6 if zone label has no 'd' value; doesn't apply to houseplex or house with secondary suite
Rear addition to a house built before Oct 15, 1953: total FSI up to 0.69; no closer to side lot line than existing wall; previous addition >=5 years old
Min front setback 6.0 m (unless 10.5.40.70(1) applies)
Min rear setback 7.5 m
Min side setback 0.9 m (detached, semi, houseplex, townhouse fronting street)
Side setback may be 0.45 m if that side has no windows or doors
Min lot frontage = 'f' value; 6.0 m if none
Ancillary buildings max 5% of lot area (pools and garages up to 1 space/unit excluded; waived if total coverage <=45% with houseplex/suite)
Ancillary building with parking: 1.0 m from a rear/side lot line abutting a street or lane
Lot frontage 7.6 m or less: no vehicle entrance through the front main wall
Corner lot or lot abutting a lane: parking access must be from the flanking street or lane
Height measured from established grade to the highest point of the building
notes: Define 'established grade' in Ch. 800.

rule: Antennae, flagpoles, satellite dishes, green-roof parapets may exceed max height by 1.5 m
Rooftop solar on a house may exceed max height by up to 1.2 m; not in front yard or street side yard
Platform at/below first storey: floor no more than 1.2 m above ground
notes: Attached at side wall: no higher than access floor.

rule: Platform at 2nd storey or above: floor no more than 0.2 m above floor it serves
Front platform (first storey or below) may encroach the lesser of 2.5 m or 50% of the required front setback
notes: Above first storey: lesser of 1.5 m or 50%.

rule: Rear platform (first storey or below) may encroach the lesser of 2.5 m or 50% of the required rear setback
notes: Side distance >= greater of 0.3 m or platform height.

rule: Side-yard platform (first storey or below) may encroach up to 1.5 m, at least 0.3 m from side lot line
notes: Above first storey: only if side yard abuts a street.

rule: Exterior stairs: max 2.0 m wide, at least 0.6 m from lot line
Bay/box windows: front or rear up to 0.75 m if <=65% of wall width; side up to 0.6 m if <=30% of wall and >=0.6 m from lot line
Eaves may project up to 0.9 m, at least 0.3 m from lot line
Air conditioner may project 0.9 m into rear setback; into side setback only if not above first storey
Front yard landscaping: frontage <6 m all except driveway; 6 to <15 m at least 50%; >=15 m at least 60%
notes: 60% if frontage >=15 m.

rule: At least 75% of required front landscaping must be soft (grass, plants)
Rear yard soft landscaping: at least 50% (frontage > 6 m) or 25% (frontage <= 6 m)
Corner lot: side yard abutting street at least 60% landscaped, 75% of that soft
No ancillary buildings in the front yard
No living accommodation in ancillary buildings (except garden/laneway suites under Ch. 150)
Ancillary building max 1 storey
Ancillary building max height 2.5 m if within 1.8 m of the house; 4.0 m otherwise
Ancillary building rear setback 0.3 m (general case)
applies_when: Lot depth <=45 m or small building
notes: Deep lots (>45 m) with height >2.5 m or >10 m²: half the height.

rule: Ancillary in rear yard, 1.8 m+ from house: side setback 0.3 m (general case)
notes: If in a side yard or <1.8 m from house: same as house side setback.

rule: Ancillary building at least 1.8 m from the house if over 2.5 m high or over 10 m²
Total ancillary floor area max 60 m² (frontage >=12 m) or 40 m² (other lots)
notes: 40 m² if frontage < 12 m. Within 1.8 m of house: max 10 m².

rule: All ancillary buildings max 10% of lot area
Detached garage with lane access: 1.0 m from lane lot line; any ancillary building 2.5 m from original lane centreline
Open deck (platform) in rear/side: setback at least the greater of 0.3 m or its height above grade
Pool rear setback 1.2 m (through lot 25.0 m, corner lot 3.0 m)
Pool side setback = greater of 1.2 m or the house's side setback (street side: house setback + 1.5 m)
Pool water surface max 15% of lot area (not counted in lot coverage)
notes: Pool enclosure (fence) rules are a separate bylaw.

rule: Ground AC/heat pump in front yard at least 6.0 m from front lot line
No parking in front yard or street side yard except on a permitted driveway
notes: Front yard parking pads need a City licence (Ch. 918).

rule: Max 2 outdoor parking spaces in the rear yard
Driveway width 2.0 to 2.6 m
notes: Min 2.0 m.

rule: Driveway max = lesser of 6.0 m or width of parking behind front wall (2.6 m if all parking in rear yard)
notes: Min 2.0 m.

rule: Driveway max = lesser of 9.0 m or width of parking behind front wall
Combined garage door width max 6.0 m
A detached house may be converted to a houseplex if new units fit entirely within the building as it existed before the permit; additions must comply or get a minor variance
notes: Lawfully existing' = authorized on or before June 26, 2025.

rule: Secondary suite allowed in a detached house, semi-detached house, or townhouse
One secondary suite per dwelling unit
Secondary suite(s) max 45% of the interior floor area of the dwelling unit
Exception: suite may take the whole basement of a one-storey detached house
Secondary suite parking may be on the front-yard driveway
Max one ancillary building with a garden or laneway suite per lot (not both)
Rear yard soft landscaping: at least 50% across full lot width (frontage > 6 m) or 25% (<= 6 m)
Rear setback 1.5 m; on lots deeper than 45 m: greater of 1.5 m or half the suite height
notes: Applies above and below ground (not footings).

rule: Add 1.5 m to rear setback if rear windows are above 4.0 m and rear lot line abuts a residential lot
Side setback (side with doors/windows) = greater of 1.5 m or 10% of frontage, max 3.0 m
Side setback (no openings) = greater of 0.6 m or 10% of frontage, max 3.0 m
Corner lot (other cases): greater of house's side setback or 1.5 m; with parking from side street: 6.0 m
Through lot with parking from rear street: greater of neighbour's front setback or 6.0 m
Separation from the house: at least 4.0 m if suite is 4.0 m tall or less
Separation from the house: at least 7.5 m if suite is taller than 4.0 m
notes: Certain east-end ravine areas: 5.0 m (150.7.60.30(1)(C)).

rule: Max height 4.0 m if within 7.5 m of the house
Max height 6.3 m if 7.5 m or more from the house
Max 2 storeys
Skylights +0.3 m; antennae/flagpoles +1.0 m; rooftop equipment +1.0 m (<=30% of roof, >=1.0 m from walls); solar +1.2 m
Max gross floor area 120 m²
Max gross floor area 60 m² for a one-storey suite
Suite floor area must be less than the house's floor area; not counted in the lot's FSI
All buildings combined max 45% of lot area, OR suite excluded and all ancillary buildings max 20%
notes: Also subject to Lot Coverage Overlay value.

rule: Platform (deck) area less than 10% of suite interior floor area; side-facing sides need 1.5 m opaque screen
notes: Floor max 0.2 m above floor it serves.

rule: No parking required for the suite or house; at least 2 bicycle parking spaces; vehicle access only from existing driveway
Garden suite needs firefighter access route from the street
section: Extract from 2024 OBC (fire access to houses not facing a street)
notes: Look up exact path width/distance in Part 9 before building.

rule: Lot must abut a lane for at least 3.5 m (rear or side, or combined)
notes: If not, check garden suite rules instead.

rule: Soft landscaping between house and suite: at least 85% (frontage > 6 m, minus a 1.5 m walkway) or 60% (<= 6 m)
Area between suite and lane (minus driveway and walkway) at least 75% soft landscaping
Rear setback 1.0 m (0.0 m if rear line doesn't abut a street/lane and wall has no openings)
Side setback 1.0 m (0.0 m if no openings and not abutting street/lane; street side = house's side setback)
notes: Next to a residential lot's rear line: 1.5 m above 4.0 m height.

rule: Separation from the house: 4.0 m if suite <= 4.0 m tall; 7.5 m if taller
notes: 7.5 m if height > 4.0 m.

rule: Max building length 10.0 m
Max building width 8.0 m
Max height 4.0 m if less than 7.5 m from the house; 6.3 m if 7.5 m or more
notes: 4.0 m if closer than 7.5 m.

rule: Max 2 storeys
Rooftop equipment may exceed height by 1.5 m (<=30% of roof, >=1.5 m from walls); skylights +0.3 m
Floor area must be less than the house's; not counted in FSI
Deck area less than 10% of suite floor area; floor max 4.0 m above grade (unless facing the lane); 1.5 m side screen
Suite not counted in lot coverage; all ancillary buildings combined max 30% of lot area
No parking required for suite or house; at least 2 bicycle spaces
Up to 3 residential units allowed as-of-right on urban residential lots with a detached, semi, or rowhouse (e.g. house + suite + garden suite)
notes: Province overrides city zoning that would block these units.

rule: For ARU projects, a city can't require buildings to be more than 4 m apart (a city bylaw allowing less still wins)
source: O. Reg. 299/19 (as amended by O. Reg. 462/24)
notes: Read e-Laws text before coding. Compare with GS-10 / LS-06.

rule: For ARU projects, lot coverage of at least 45% must be allowed (a city bylaw allowing more still wins)
source: O. Reg. 299/19 (as amended by O. Reg. 462/24)
notes: Read e-Laws text before coding.

rule: Private stairs: run between 255 mm and 355 mm
notes: Max run 355 mm. Extract rise limits from the same table.

rule: Every floor with a bedroom needs an outside window (or door) openable from inside without tools
notes: Extract min opening area/dimensions from 9.9.10.1.

rule: Egress window sill max 1000 mm above the floor
Egress window in a window well: at least 550 mm clearance in front of the window
Openable windows with sill under 900 mm and a drop over 1800 mm need a guard or opening limiter
Stair rise, headroom and width; guard heights for decks and stairs
notes: Extract values from the Compendium.

rule: Ceiling heights and room sizes
Smoke alarms and carbon monoxide alarms
Fire separations and sound between dwelling units; secondary suite rules
Spatial separation: limits on windows close to property lines
Energy efficiency compliance package
Converting an existing house to 2+ units must meet Fire Code retrofit rules
Property is shown grey on the zoning map (old pre-amalgamation bylaw): stop and tell user to check with Toronto Building
notes: Never guess rules for grey properties.

rule: Site-specific exception on the zone label (x###): show a warning that extra rules apply
applies_when: Zone label has an exception number

rule: Designated heritage property (Part IV): changes need heritage consent
Property in a Heritage Conservation District: needs a heritage permit
notes: Also run the vibes check against that HCD plan.

rule: Property in TRCA regulated area: needs a TRCA permit
Property in a ravine-protected area: tree/grading permit under Ch. 658
Work near city trees (any size) or private trees at or above the protected size: tree permit + Tree Declaration form
notes: 30 cm was the private-tree threshold; check the Sept 1, 2026 amendments (By-law 402-2026).

rule: Project doesn't meet zoning: needs a minor variance from Committee of Adjustment (four tests: minor, desirable, meets intent of zoning, meets intent of Official Plan)
notes: Feeds the 'variance path' feature.

rule: Site plan control: check exemption for small residential (up to 10 units)
source: Site Plan Control By-law 774-2012 + Planning Act s. 41
notes: Confirm the exemption wording in the Planning Act.

rule: Near St. Michael's Hospital or SickKids: check helicopter flightpath height limits
Electrical work: separate ESA permit
Gas appliance work: regulated by TSSA (licensed contractor)
Industrial/commercial property becoming residential: Record of Site Condition
Next to a provincial highway: MTO Building and Land Use Permit
source: Public Transportation and Highway Improvement Act

rule: Renovating a unit with tenants: rental renovation licence may be needed
New curb cut or front yard parking pad: City approval under Ch. 918 / Ch. 743
Demolishing a house: demolition permit and demolition control rules
Residential infill public notice may apply to additions and new houses
Anything not covered: 'This may need other approvals. Check with Toronto Building.'
notes: Use the applicable law list as the final checklist.
